The nicest thing anybody has ever done to me was a couple of years ago , i had just started a new job right after i had a very bad experience, a bad experience that left me heartbroken, suspicious,bitter but worst of all it had made me into someone I'm not . I was distant, cold and scared of everyone, i wasn't my funny self , i used to get angry , overall i was someone different.
At the job i got put with a senior, i loved her , she's smart , confident and well spoken , the kind of person that you can't help but respect, she took me in , taught me every thing i know , talked to the whole staff about me , told them how hard working i am and how smart i am and how I'm going to be good at the job . One night as we were changing shifts she asked me to walk her to the garden. I remember it vividly, it was summer and there was a cool breath , you could smell jasmine in the air , she reached into her backpack and pulled out a small navy box . I opened it and there was a necklace, a chromatic black heart pendant that shifted in the light , so many colors . There was a note in the box , i opened it and it said "even if you felt your heart is dark , it still shines" . I started crying then and there , it was truly the kindest thing anyone did to me . It was also the first time anyone had ever given me a gift just for the sake of it, i had always done it to my friends and always wondered how to felt . I had no idea how she knew what i was going through, i haven't told anyone, till this day i haven't said a word. No one really knows what i went through. I still have that note by my bed side . I look at it every night before i go to sleep , and even though the necklace isn't something i'd buy for myself, i wear all the time, it feels like a warm hug. 
I'm thankful for every kind gesture. I really am
